summary: For an activation that keeps restarting, open it under Automation Decisions > Rulebook Activations, check the History output and the Restart policy (On failure restarts point to a failure), check the YAML and instance logs, and if needed recreate it with Log level Debug and inspect the new output.
questions: Why does my rulebook activation keep restarting?
How do I get debug logs for a rulebook activation?
Can I change the log level of an existing activation?
